external_prior_art.finding: 2019 reported a fabricated 4x4 switch based on four 2x2 MZIs; topology novelty NOT claimed
external_prior_art.title: Silicon nitride based polarization-independent 4x4 optical matrix switch

external_prior_art.finding: measured nonzero crosstalk and phase error require device calibration
external_prior_art.title: Calibration-Free Mach-Zehnder Silicon-Photonic Switch

modeling_gates: fixed second-stage optical pairings (0,2),(1,3) require routing/crossings in a real planar PIC
uniform crossing loss is illustrative; actual optical path mismatch and coupler insertion loss may vary
MZI cross state carries relative global phase i, requiring tracked phase reference for quantum-coherent routing
binary control words may broadcast, yet fabrication drift requires independently characterized per-cell trim
4 reachable XOR permutations out of 24 S4 permutations; this is a restricted switch, not a general 4x4 crossbar
every child touches four line buses simultaneously; physical sources, modes, switch arbitration and quantum protocols remain unresolved
no gdsfactory, PDK, physical waveguides, DRC, electrodes, measurements, optical power budget or chip fabrication
phase_frame: i^(popcount(mask)) is global per ideal isolated bus; relative phase across buses requires tracking
scope: exact restricted 4x4 XOR family, ideal MZI; hypothetical model only
